_readme: Paid tiers, lowest rank first (rank follows the Buy Me a Coffee price). bmcLevelIds: Buy Me a Coffee membership level ids (from a webhook event's membership_level_id; preferred, they survive renames). bmcLevels: level names as on the Buy Me a Coffee page (case-insensitive fallback). discordRoleIds: Discord role ids; either id counts, so the visible class role and the hidden access role (kept when a member uses /discreet) both work (Server Settings > Roles > right-click > Copy Role ID, with Developer Mode on). A member gets the highest tier any source gives them; members with no paid tier get no tier group and no badge.

tiers.description: Asylum seekers. Pay no taxes, work hard, still part of the Closet Republic.
